ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly polarized; approximately 92% low-intensity black pixels and 8% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across the visible ventral plane.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is solid low-intensity black. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes. Sparse, high-contrast white linear streaks and point-source pixels are scattered across the central and lower regions of the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with a calculated wide angle of approximately 135 degrees; vertical pixel depth is low relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude ragged edges, particularly pronounced toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning into an upward-slanting linear trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel rings localized on the outer distal tips of both lobes. A single, distinct white annular ring (approximate diameter 15 pixels) is located in the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent near-vertical white scratch on the left lobe; multiple fine, unaligned horizontal and diagonal linear disruptions across the lower central fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated scarring on the distal extremities; multiple white linear rake marks distributed across the dark ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique donut-shaped annular scar on the mid-left lobe ventral surface.
